name: Discover STEM (University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering)
org: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering Student Services
what_you_do: Spend one week on the University of Minnesota Twin Cities campus. You learn about current research and careers. You see talks and lab tours. You see science experiments and technology demos. You join Q&A sessions.
who_can_apply: High school students entering grade 11 or 12. Priority goes to students who have not been in Discover STEM before. Admission is competitive, and the program especially encourages applicants from underrepresented communities.
pay_detail: The page says there is no cost to apply and attend, thanks to 3M. It also mentions an enrollment fee or scholarship request after admission, so confirm that nothing is charged.
duration: 1 week, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. daily (day program)
deadline_text: Summer 2026: sessions were Aug 3 to 7 and Aug 10 to 14, 2026. Applications were open April 20 to May 18, 2026 and decisions went out by May 29. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online, or by mail on request. Send an unofficial high school transcript and personal statement answers. Do not send the application in pieces. Those are not reviewed.
notes: The camps page for the college also lists other high school options, such as the Run the World AI Explorers Camp (grades 11 and 12) and a Summer Computer Academy for girls in grades 6 to 12. Not a job.
